insights.note: Breakdown of all 63 submitted applications by role type and by company, compiled from the full campaign log. Session update (2026-08-03, fresh search cycle): per user request, ran a full search-and-apply cycle across LinkedIn, Naukri, Foundit and Indeed for Operations Manager / Team Leader / Customer Service Manager roles. No genuinely new matches were found - LinkedIn (Operations Manager, Team Leader Operations, Team Leader BPO, India, past 24h) returned near-identical result sets across all three queries dominated by mismatched domains (hospitality, civil engineering, IT infra) or entry-level postings. Naukri (Operations Manager broad search, and Team Leader Operations in Kolkata, 5+ yrs) surfaced overwhelmingly 0-5yr entry-level, retail/insurance-sales, or unrelated-domain roles. Foundit (Team Leader Operations, Kolkata) resurfaced Titanium Consulting's US Healthcare Team Leader/Operations Manager and TP Health's Process Trainer, both already investigated and skipped in prior sessions as domain mismatches. Indeed (Operations Manager BPO, India, last 24h) surfaced 6 results: BT's People & Culture Professional (HR Business Partner role, mismatch), Aanvii Hearing Solutions' Team Lead-HCA (hearing-aid sales, low salary, mismatch), EXL's Lead Assistant Manager HCA (healthcare-specific), MetLife's Senior Manager-Operations (actually a Finance Technology/Workday ERP role, mismatch), Sara Infotech's manager-Healthcare BPO (US healthcare patient-communication domain, mismatch, same pattern as prior Titanium Consulting skip), and two Qode (fintech PPI wallet) roles - Lead-Customer Operations & Support (L2) and Manager-Business Operations Support (L2 & Cross-Functional) - both requiring specific RBI Ombudsman/Nodal Officer/PPI wallet regulatory grievance-handling experience that Resume_4 does not demonstrate, so both were skipped as genuine domain mismatches rather than applied to speculatively. No new applications submitted this session; counts unchanged (applied 83, rejected 32, awaiting 51, blocked 18). Rejection check (2026-08-03, continued): searched Gmail for rejection-pattern language after 2026-07-28. Found one genuine new rejection - ShipBob's 'Manager, Control Tower' role, rejected 2026-08-03 ('we have decided to move forward with other candidates'). This application (submitted 2026-07-22, confirmed via ShipBob's 'Thank you for applying' email) had never been logged in recentApplications or counted in the applied total, so it was backfilled as both applied and rejected in the same update. Fresh Prints' Order Processing Associate rejection was also re-surfaced by the search but was already logged (2026-08-01). No other genuine rejections found among 11 matches - the rest were application-confirmation/status emails (DHL, Amazon assessment, Wipro, UPS, HDFC Bank) or unrelated newsletters, not rejections. Applied count updated 83->84 (ShipBob backfill), rejected updated 32->33, awaiting unchanged at 51. Full Gmail reconciliation (2026-08-03): per user request, rebuilt the applied and awaiting lists from scratch by auditing Gmail across all of 2026 and cross-checking against each platform's own application-history page. Gmail searches covered ATS/company confirmation language ('thank you for applying', 'application received', 'we have received your application', 'application submitted') plus platform-specific confirmations from LinkedIn (jobs-noreply), Indeed (indeedapply), Naukri (info@naukri.com 'You applied for N jobs'), and foundit/Monster ('Application Successful'). Because Naukri's multi-job confirmation emails only render the first role in the message body, and LinkedIn's confirmations name only the company and not the role, the role/company/date detail was completed from LinkedIn's My Jobs > Applied tracker (44 entries, 37 of them in 2026) and Naukri's Application History page (43 total applies: 35 on-Naukri + 8 external web jobs). RESULT: 142 verified applications in 2026, versus the 84 previously recorded - the dashboard had been tracking only the applications made during these Claude sessions plus a handful of backfills, and was missing roughly 58 earlier applications the user had submitted independently (notably a large block of AML/transaction-monitoring roles applied via Naukri in May-July, the Amazon.jobs internal applications, and a set of direct-ATS applications to HSBC, Capgemini, Goldman Sachs, OpenAI, Scale AI, FedEx, Pearson, Wise, Holafly, AML RightSource and others). Each application is now stored in a new 'applications' array carrying company, role, date, source platform and a status of either 'rejected' or 'awaiting'; the applications with no rejection email are additionally mirrored into a new 'awaiting' array so the dashboard can render applied and awaiting separately. Nine further applications are recorded that were evidenced only by their rejection email with no surviving confirmation (five Revolut FinCrime roles, three JPMorgan Chase roles, and Microsoft's Logistics Technician) - their dates are the rejection date less a short interval and should be treated as approximate. Seven Indeed applications from 2026-07-19 are logged with the role title only, because Indeed's confirmation emails do not name the employer. Counts updated: applied 84->142, rejected held at 33 (the Gmail rejection audit found no additional rejections), awaiting 51->109, blocked unchanged at 18. Scope was limited to 2026 per user instruction; pre-2026 applications visible in LinkedIn's tracker (Beam, Bookspert, Allcargo Logistics, WhiteSlips, SVF Entertainment, Triple, Concentrix) were deliberately excluded as out of campaign scope. Email mapping (2026-08-03): every entry in the applications and awaiting arrays now carries a gmailLink pointing at its own confirmation email, matching how the rejections tab already worked - 124 of 142 link straight to the 'thank you for applying' / 'application sent' message from the employer, ATS or job board. Nine further entries (five Revolut FinCrime roles, three JPMorgan Chase roles, Microsoft Logistics Technician) link to their rejection email instead and are tagged with an emailNote, because no confirmation email survives for them. The remaining nine (Flexiple x2, Barclays, Amazon Last Mile, Wipro, Clearview Capital Advisors, TP Team Lead, Care Health Insurance, TP Vision) were submitted through in-session portal flows that never sent a confirmation email and are tagged accordingly. Note that Naukri batches several same-day applications into one confirmation email, so a few Naukri entries share a gmailLink. One additional genuine rejection was discovered during this mapping pass and added: HSBC Group's Wealth Operations Executive (Job ID 43808), rejected 2026-06-03 - its template opens with 'Thank you for applying' before the regret language, which is why earlier keyword sweeps had classified it as a confirmation. Counts updated: rejected 33->34, awaiting 109->108, applied unchanged at 142. Session update (2026-08-04): ran a fresh search-and-apply cycle across LinkedIn, Naukri, Foundit and Indeed. No genuine matches found; no applications submitted; counts unchanged at applied 142, rejected 34, awaiting 108, blocked 18. LinkedIn: searched Operations Manager (India, 48h), Team Leader Operations (Kolkata, 7d), Customer Support Manager (remote, 7d) and Operations Manager (remote, 7d). Results were dominated by unrelated functions - Databricks engineering, marketing operations, Amazon Ads, crypto/institutional finance, strategy and product roles. Two were read in full: Jobgether's Service Desk Team Lead (India, remote, 6-month contract, up to INR 75,000/month) is an IT service desk role requiring ITIL v4 Foundation certification as a hard prerequisite plus Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, ServiceNow/ITSM and AWS/Azure knowledge - skipped, as Resume_4 is customer-support/BPO operations rather than IT infrastructure. Standard Chartered's Client Service Manager (Kolkata) was noted but is a distribution-network banking role. Naukri: Team Leader Operations in Kolkata with a 5+ yrs and last-3-days filter returned 20 postings, all mismatches - Axis Max Life and Bajaj/Bharti AXA insurance sales, Little Shop retail sales, Glenmark and Abbott pharma field sales, a Xerox Java Developer role, an Amity Registrar post and a Medhavi visiting-faculty post; the only operations-titled result (Airhs Ticketing & Operations Executive) was 0-5 yrs at INR 1.8-2.4 LPA. A broader all-India 'operations manager BPO' search returned 777 results but Naukri's experience filter did not hold and the listings were freshers, telecalling and insurance sales. Indeed: a Kolkata search for team leader / operations manager / customer service manager returned only 6 postings, all far below band (Tele Caller INR 14-16K/month, ELD Customer Support INR 15-18K/month, Back Office Assistant INR 12-18K/month, a hospitality Banquet Assistant Manager and a Team Leader-Sales at INR 20-30K/month). An all-India equivalent surfaced ResultsCX's Manager, Operations - Motor Insurance BPO (Bengaluru), which was read in full and skipped: it requires 10-14 years overall experience with hands-on UK General Insurance / Motor insurance exposure, 4-6 years insurance-operations leadership and FCA / Consumer Duty regulatory knowledge, none of which Resume_4 demonstrates. Also re-surfaced and skipped were Aanvii Hearing Solutions' Team Lead-HCA and CHRO Consulting's Operations Manager - US Healthcare Process (Voice), the latter matching the US-healthcare-domain pattern already skipped for Titanium Consulting and Sara Infotech. Foundit: Operations Manager in Kolkata, 5-10 yrs, last 3 days returned just 2 postings - an insurance corporate-sales BDM and a B2B/SEO Marketing Manager - both mismatches. Observation for future cycles: the Kolkata market at this level is thin and the same postings keep recirculating, so widening to remote-first roles or adjacent titles (Service Delivery Manager, Customer Success Manager, Support Operations Lead) may produce better yield than repeating the same keyword set. Session update (2026-08-04, adjacent-title cycle): per the previous session's recommendation, widened the search away from 'Team Leader' / 'Operations Manager' keywords to adjacent titles that describe the same work. Searched LinkedIn for Service Delivery Manager, Customer Success Manager and Support Operations roles, remote-first, India, past 7 days. Service Delivery Manager skewed almost entirely to IT project management and SAP delivery (Hired, Jobgether, Jobs Ai, Ethos, Syntax, Ledelsea) - no matches. Customer Success Manager produced the result the wider net was meant to find: APPLIED to Flexiple's Customer Success Manager (remote India, explicitly including Kolkata, for a VC-backed SaaS company building its founding India customer success team). The role asks for 3-7 years in customer success, account management 'or a related role', account ownership from onboarding through renewal, churn-risk monitoring and stakeholder reviews - the same 3-7 yr band as the Flexiple Service Operations Manager already in Screening, and a genuine fit for Resume_4's support-and-team-management background. B2B SaaS and Gainsight/HubSpot familiarity are listed as preferred, not required. The LinkedIn Apply link routed to Flexiple's portal, which registered the application as In Progress rather than auto-submitting as it did in July; completing it required a second step through Applications > Continue Application, where a 'Complete your submission' form appeared pre-filled from the existing Flexiple profile (resume on file, current CTC 772000, expected CTC 800000, notice period 'I can join immediately' - all previously supplied by the user, none newly entered by Claude). Submission confirmed: 'Application completed successfully', status In review / Screening, Flexiple application id 68078925. Also skipped after reading the full JD: Jobgether's Service Desk Team Lead (ITIL v4 Foundation certification listed as a hard requirement, plus Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, ServiceNow and AWS/Azure - IT infrastructure, not support operations) and ResultsCX's Manager, Operations - Motor Insurance BPO (10-14 yrs with UK General Insurance and FCA exposure). BACKFILL: while verifying the submission, Flexiple's Closed tab revealed a third pre-existing application never recorded here - Plum, Mobile App Engineer, applied 12 Jul 2026, marked 'Shortlisted by Flexiple' but now closed. Flagging that this role is well outside Resume_4's profile and was not submitted by Claude; it appears to date from the same 12 Jul session as the previously-backfilled Flexiple Operations Manager application. It is counted as applied and, since Flexiple lists it as Closed with no further action possible, as rejected - though no rejection email exists, so this is a platform-side closure rather than an employer decision. Counts updated: applied 142->144, rejected 34->35, awaiting 108->109, blocked unchanged at 18. Consistency fix (2026-08-04): the Plum / Mobile App Engineer closure had been added to the applications array as rejected but not to the rejections array, so the Rejections tile read 35 while the Rejections list header read 34. It is now present in both; the entry carries a note rather than a gmailLink because it is a Flexiple platform closure with no rejection email. | 2026-08-05 cycle: searched LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri and Foundit across core and adjacent titles. Applied to SiteRecon Customer Success Manager (LinkedIn Easy Apply) and Flowras Customer Success Manager (company site form). Naukri and Foundit returned no genuine matches this cycle. | Gmail rejection sweep 2026-08-05: logged Scale AI - Operations Program Manager (rejected 2026-08-04, role filled) and removed duplicate Fresh Prints entries.
